g.text: Sharing the AI curator's verdict as a card

text.tspan: the settled verdict and its note
The curator writes the card line
its character's voice: a playful reaction
and a wish for what comes next

ul.li: The line is written from the settled verdict, never the proposal the rule overturned.
Written once, then read back: no model call on every open.
Only the project's team opens the card; no public page holds the letter.
